note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_activity.py; type=manual require agent/render/test-solve inspection.

GATE_1_contract_architecture.text: Title preserved; trademark scan passed (no branded properties); medical/therapeutic claims stripped or softened
Dominant activity family + supporting families locked; Language-Independence Classification recorded per item
Audience band locked with accessibility route where applicable
Page map totals exactly 100 (or documented even 96-104 exception)
Count ledger reconciles: promised count vs activity pages vs solution budget vs blank backs vs front/closing = approved total
Single-sided blank-back budget explicit for coloring/cut-out; subtitle count numbers match the ledger
Risk register written; contract frozen with project_id/edition_id

GATE_2_manifest_sample.text: Every planned item has a manifest row with source data created before page design
10-page sample (when required) shows premise, instructions, >=4 substantive activities, visual system, answer loop; hardest mechanics prototyped
Visual specification locked; sample images pass acceptance (ledger match, no unintended clues, contrast, safe text zones)
Originality vs references: functional completeness high, expressive similarity low; zero reference pixels in assets

GATE_3_full_content.text: 100% solvability audit per mechanic; uniqueness verified wherever promised (sudoku/kakuro/logic)
Duplicate-puzzle scan on content hashes; word-search overlap under threshold; no duplicate grids/topologies
Difficulty arc audited by test-solve; progression monotone within sections; labels match solve experience
No supporting mechanic over ~40% of activity pages; no adjacent mechanic+theme repeats
Accidental offensive-string scan passed on all letter grids in every declared direction
Independent test-solve of a representative sample plus all uniqueness-claim items from the rendered page, not source data
Human QA: ambiguity, reading level, cultural fit, print-scale visibility, response-space adequacy, enjoyment

GATE_4_layout_sync_preflight.text: item ID <-> final page number <-> answer entry <-> visual asset <-> locale: zero mismatches
Every answer-bearing item present, correctly keyed, legible at print size; visual answers annotated
Exact page count and promised activity count confirmed on final PDF; no blanks/dupes/placeholders/crop marks/watermarks
Nothing clipped or trapped in the gutter; writing/coloring zones respect safe areas; blank backs positioned as budgeted
Images 300 ppi effective; fonts embedded with full locale glyphs; B&W pages verified for grayscale fidelity
Cover wrap after interior lock; metadata claims match files; AI disclosure recorded; live KDP previewer passes
